question: {If } cos A = (4)/(5), { find the value of } 4 + 4tan² A.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

cos A = 4/5 ⇒ right triangle ⇒ sin A = 3/5

tan A = sin A ÷ cos A = (3/5) ÷ (4/5) = 3/4

tan²A = 9/16

4 + 4tan²A = 4 + 4×(9/16)

**∴ Answer = 25/4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

cos A = 4/5

**Formula used:**

sin²A + cos²A = 1

tan A = sin A ÷ cos A

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin A = √(1 − cos²A)

⇒ = √(1 − (4/5)²)

⇒ = √(1 − 16/25)

⇒ = √(9/25) = 3/5

⇒ tan A = (3/5) ÷ (4/5) = 3/4

⇒ tan²A = 9/16

⇒ 4 + 4tan²A = 4 + 4×(9/16)

⇒ = 4 + 9/4

⇒ = 25/4

**∴ The correct answer is 25/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identity

sin²A + cos²A = 1

Trigonometric Ratios

tan A = sin A ÷ cos A

Right Triangle Trick

If cos A = 4/5, triangle sides follow 3-4-5 ratio

Square Concept

(a/b)² = a²/b²
